notes.title: Campfire Tales 2.0.0 Update!
notes.content:
Campfire Tales v.2.0.0

*Removed screen resize limitation
*Extended act 3 with key fetch quest
*Added "Parabellum Games" to credits, (Characters used in new act 4)
*Changed title screen to press "start" or "A" (Z) to continue
*Added face to rock in forest
*Modified the mushrooms making them portals to another world 
*Added nice hint bunny
*Added second floor to the Ranger Station "Snoopy You!"
*Added animation to the underground mole
*Added a small act 4
